config.purpose: Exploratory W-01 local SSR pilot; not a confirmatory thesis benchmark
limitations: Single laptop with balanced power plan; background activity and CPU frequency are not controlled
Server uses logical CPU 0; generator uses logical CPUs 2 and 4; physical-core topology is not established
No enforced memory budget; process working set and private bytes are observed
Short windows and two repetitions are exploratory, not proof of sustained capacity
The workload has no personalized data or native I/O and does not establish identity isolation
JavaScript engine versions and integration/delivery paths differ between variants
